title: Student Privacy & Campus Surveillance Policy Template
metaDescription: Comprehensive policy template for protecting student data and establishing clear campus surveillance guidelines. Covers FERPA compliance and digital privacy.
description: A comprehensive policy template designed to help educational institutions establish clear guidelines for student privacy protection and campus surveillance practices while ensuring FERPA compliance and digital rights protection.

sections.heading: Policy Overview and Purpose
sections.content: This policy establishes [INSTITUTION_NAME]'s commitment to protecting student privacy while maintaining necessary security measures. Our institution recognizes the fundamental right to privacy in educational settings and aims to balance student safety with data protection. This policy covers all forms of data collection, surveillance activities, and digital monitoring that may impact student privacy. All faculty, staff, and third-party vendors must comply with these guidelines to ensure consistent protection of student information and rights.

sections.heading: Student Data Collection and Usage
sections.content: Student data collection is limited to educational purposes and institutional operations as defined by FERPA. Personal information collected includes academic records, attendance, disciplinary actions, and necessary contact information. We prohibit the collection of sensitive personal data unless required by law or essential for student safety. All data collection must have clear educational justification and be documented. Students and parents have the right to access, review, and request corrections to their educational records. Data retention periods are established according to [RETENTION_PERIOD] and legal requirements.

sections.heading: Campus Surveillance Systems
sections.content: Physical surveillance cameras are installed only in public areas where safety and security are paramount. No surveillance devices are placed in private areas such as restrooms, locker rooms, or dormitory rooms. All camera locations are clearly marked and documented. Recorded footage is stored securely for [FOOTAGE_RETENTION] days unless required for ongoing investigations. Access to surveillance footage is restricted to authorized security personnel and administrators. Students will be notified of surveillance areas through posted signage and orientation materials.

sections.heading: Digital Monitoring and Device Usage
sections.content: School-issued devices may include monitoring software necessary for educational management and security. Students and parents will receive clear disclosure about monitoring capabilities and limitations. Personal devices connected to school networks are subject to basic network monitoring for security purposes only. Digital proctoring software used during examinations will clearly disclose monitoring features and data collection practices. Students have the right to use privacy tools like a privacy-focused browser for personal browsing when permitted by acceptable use policies.

sections.heading: Third-Party Educational Technology
sections.content: All educational technology vendors must demonstrate FERPA compliance before implementation. Third-party applications require data processing agreements that limit data usage to educational purposes. Regular audits of edtech providers ensure ongoing compliance with privacy standards. Students and parents receive notification when new educational technology tools are introduced. Vendors are prohibited from using student data for commercial purposes or advertising. Alternative options are provided when possible for students who opt out of specific technologies.

sections.heading: Student Rights and Consent
sections.content: Students have the right to know what data is collected and how it's used. Opt-out procedures are available for non-essential data collection activities. Students can request access to their data and surveillance records as permitted by law. Privacy concerns and complaints are addressed through [CONTACT_DEPARTMENT] within [RESPONSE_TIME] business days. Annual privacy training is provided to all students regarding their rights and institutional practices. Parents of minor students receive the same rights and notifications as applicable under FERPA.

sections.heading: Compliance and Enforcement
sections.content: This policy is reviewed annually and updated as necessary to reflect changing laws and technologies. All staff receive mandatory training on student privacy requirements and surveillance protocols. Violations of this policy result in disciplinary action and potential legal consequences. Regular compliance audits ensure adherence to FERPA, state privacy laws, and institutional standards. Incident response procedures are in place for any privacy breaches or unauthorized surveillance. Legal counsel is consulted for complex privacy matters and policy updates.

Educational institutions preparing for FERPA compliance audits
